semantic_evidence.finding: The unchanged English has an existential did-any clause followed by two positive-answer roles: which TS and what impact type. Required specNumber plus impactType supplies both roles; a nonempty documented NewTS witness answers yes. An empty collection would not certify no and is excluded by the prospective positive-witness premise; a Boolean alone cannot replace either role.
semantic_evidence.original_quote: Did the Ambient IoT study (TR 38.769) create any new TS? If so, which TS and what impact type?
query_clauses: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber:'38.769'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(impact:TRImpact {impactType:'NewTS'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(spec:Spec)
RETURN DISTINCT spec.specNumber AS specNumber, impact.impactType AS impactType, tr.trNumber AS trNumber
ORDER BY impactType ASC, trNumber ASC
